Frequently asked questions about Iuliana Elena Demetrescu
 Sample of 19 matches, from 02/11/2024 to 17/10/2026. Answers refer to the matches in the table and the selected filters.
 Card totals and percentages use yellow plus red cards in this sample.
 What is Iuliana Elena Demetrescu’s average number of cards per match?
 Iuliana Elena Demetrescu averages 2.95 yellow cards and 0.21 red cards per match across the 19 matches analysed: 3.16 cards per match in total.
 What are Iuliana Elena Demetrescu’s penalty statistics?
 Iuliana Elena Demetrescu has awarded 8 penalties in the 19 matches analysed, averaging 0.42 per match.
 How often does Iuliana Elena Demetrescu exceed 3.5, 4.5 and 5.5 cards?
 Across the 19 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 36.8% of matches, 4.5 in 26.3% and 5.5 in 10.5%.
 How much does Iuliana Elena Demetrescu’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 19 matches analysed, 36.8% ended with 0–2 cards, 52.6% with 3–5 and 10.5% with 6 or more.
 How do Iuliana Elena Demetrescu’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 2.70 cards, compared with 3.16 across all 19 matches analysed.
 How does Iuliana Elena Demetrescu distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 19 matches analysed, home teams average 1.32 yellow cards and away teams 1.63. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
